scheme_name: DigiLocker API Integration for Fintech KYC
overview: DigiLocker is a flagship initiative of the Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY) under the Digital India programme. It provides a secure cloud-based platform for storage, sharing, and verification of digital documents and certificates. DigiLocker aims at 'Digital Empowerment' of citizens by enabling access to authentic digital documents anytime, anywhere, with legal validity at par with original physical documents as per IT Rules 2016.
objectives: Provide access to authentic digital documents to citizens' digital document wallet
Enable secure storage, sharing, and verification of documents & certificates
Reduce administrative overhead through paperless governance
Facilitate real-time verification of documents from issuing agencies
Promote digital transformation and secure document exchange between trusted issuers and requesters
eligibility: To access the DigiLocker platform, users must register using a valid Indian mobile number, Driving License, PAN or Aadhaar. Registration may require verification via an OTP. Users are using Aadhaar voluntarily.
benefits: For Citizens: Access Anytime, Anywhere; Legally Valid, Widely Trusted Digital documents; Effortless Sharing with explicit consent; Accelerate Services for jobs, government benefits, banking, healthcare, and education. For Agencies: Reduced Administrative Overhead; Digital Transformation; Trusted issued documents fetched in real-time; Secure Document Gateway; Real Time Verification enabling government agencies to verify data directly from issuers after obtaining user consent.
financial_support: No financial support is provided under DigiLocker as it is a free digital document wallet service. The platform does not charge fees for access to issued documents through DigiLocker.
application_process: 1. Register yourself using a valid Indian mobile number, Driving License, PAN or Aadhaar. 2. Verify yourself via OTP sent to your mobile number. 3. Fetch your documents from linked issuers. 4. Share your documents with consent. 5. Become a DigiLocker Partner Organization by getting registered as a DigiLocker Issuer or Requester.
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Registration is accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY), Government of India
contact_details: Email: support@digilocker.gov.in | Address: National e-Governance Division (NeGD), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, New Delhi, India
caveats: Users retain complete ownership of uploaded content and are liable for ensuring uploads do not infringe Indian laws
NeGD reserves the right to suspend or block the User's account without prior notice in case of non-compliance, security concerns, or directions from competent authorities
Users must explicitly consent before fetching or sharing any documents in their account
No fees shall be charged by NeGD for access to issued documents through DigiLocker
DigiLocker does not knowingly collect personal data from individuals under the age of 18 without verifiable parental or guardian consent
